name: timestamps
description: Times on everything in the conversation, 'replied 14:07 · took 1m 48s' on each turn, and the time with each prompt so Claude knows how much time has passed.

format.title: Hour format
format.description: auto follows your system locale; or 12h / 24h

style.title: Style
style.description: clock shows 14:05; relative shows 5m ago (today's messages only)

show.title: Where times appear
show.description: everything: under every row (your messages, Claude's replies, tool calls, command output). mine: under your own messages only

showDuration.title: Show turn duration
showDuration.description: Add 'took 1m 48s' to each turn's closing line

backfill.title: Fill in older messages
backfill.description: On /resume or /branch, read this session's own transcript file to show times for messages from before the mod loaded

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude the time
tellClaude.description: Add one sentence beside each prompt, read by Claude only, saying when it was sent and how long since the previous message. Your words are never changed
